_about: The All Day People tab's Dating and Pets sections (all-day/js/modes/people.js). Written by hand; every entry is checked on its own page and carries the source, the date and a quote. Calendar events (singles nights, dog events) are NOT here: the tab finds them on the guide's events calendar (all-day/data/whatnow.json) with people-match.js. News items older than 180 days stop showing unless evergreen is true, so a stale headline fades instead of sitting there. No em dashes in reader-facing text.

burlington.title: Burlington's dog park rules
items: Three dogs per person at most.
Dogs under voice control, and keep a leash on you.
Kids under 12 come with an adult.
No aggressive dogs, and no females in heat.
No large dogs in the small-dog area.
Leave the food and treats at home.
